subject.title: fix(sessions): preserve parent lifecycle for parallel children

question: Should `sessions.create` permanently expose the optional `succeedsParent` disposition as the public contract for distinguishing true successors from parallel parent-linked children after the reset-in-place bug is repaired?
rationale: The mechanical reset-path repair is clear, but the PR adds a compatibility-sensitive lifecycle API and defines which callers may terminate a parent; that permanent contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair and retain explicit disposition
options.body: Fix the reset-in-place ordering, keep omission as legacy rollover, and retain explicit caller declarations for successor versus parallel child semantics.

options.title: Pause for a different lifecycle contract
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers prefer an enum, a different default, or a narrower owner-specific seam instead of this gateway parameter.

recommendation.title: Repair and retain explicit disposition
recommendation.body: Fix the reset-in-place ordering, keep omission as legacy rollover, and retain explicit caller declarations for successor versus parallel child semantics.
